verdict.rationale: The skills CLI has first-party, documented bulk operations. You can install every skill from a repo with `'*'`, or several at once with repeated `--skill` flags. You can target several agents in one command (`-a claude-code -a opencode`), update all or several skills (`npx skills update`, `update frontend-design web-design-guidelines`), remove skills across several agents at once, and restore a whole set from `skills-lock.json`. All of these run non-interactively with `-y`, and a runtime probe confirmed the CLI switches itself to promptless mode under an agent. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of a bulk install, update or remove actually running (the probe only exercised `--list`), and no documented wildcard or remove-all form of `remove`.
